author: kycrafft
body:
This may have been suggested before but am failing hard at finding the thread. Anyways, the feature I am suggesting is the ability to tag someone in your post. Much like the buttons for inserting pictures and links, there would be a button to tag a player by inserting their name. 

What would this do?
This would let a player know if someone has specificly mentioned them in a thread and wants them to read the post/thread. At the bottom of your post  '@[playername]' would pop up. 

How would the person be notified:
I would imagine that it would create an alert. A secondary option would be for it to also turn the orange new post number to the left of each topic red, for easier notification. 

Why would you want to tag someone?
This can depend on the situation. You might want feedback on a map from a Map Dev, or maybe you have just posted something that you think your friend would be interested in. 

Wait! Couldn't you troll people with this?
Well, too some extent yes. But it would be really easy to just ignore the tag if you really wanted to by either not clicking on the topic or just reading the post and moving on. However I do think that there should be punishments for people who tag others excessively and unnecessarily. 

That's about it, if you have any feedback, please let me know.
